# Third-party code in ui/vendor

Convertino's PDF editor uses these free, open-source components, unchanged:

| Component | Version | Licence | Files |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PDF.js (Mozilla), legacy build for older WebViews | 6.3.289 | Apache-2.0 | `pdfjs/` (see `pdfjs/LICENSE`, `pdfjs/wasm/LICENSE_*`, `pdfjs/iccs/LICENSE`) |
| pdf-lib | 1.17.1 | MIT | `pdf-lib.min.js` (`pdf-lib.LICENSE.md`) |
| @pdf-lib/fontkit | 1.1.1 | MIT (per its package.json) | `fontkit.umd.min.js` |
| Caveat SemiBold (signatures) | Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1 | `fonts/Caveat-SemiBold.ttf` (`fonts/Caveat-OFL.txt`) |
| Noto Sans, Noto Sans Devanagari (text) | Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1 | `fonts/NotoSans*.ttf` (`fonts/NotoSans*-OFL.txt`) |
